recipes.name: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: A simple yet delicious Italian pizza with fresh ingredients, crispy crust, and aromatic basil leaves.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 475°F (245°C).
Roll out the pizza dough on a floured surface into a circular shape.
Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a thin border around the edges.
Distribute the fresh mozzarella slices evenly on top of the sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle a pinch of salt, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Creamy Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: A classic Roman pasta dish made with eggs, hard cheese, cured pork, and freshly cracked black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat a pan over medium heat and crisp the diced pancetta until golden brown. Remove garlic if used.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs together with the Pecorino Romano and Parmesan cheeses to form a thick paste. Season with black pepper.
Drain the pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Add the hot pasta directly to the pan with the pancetta off the heat. Pour the egg-cheese mixture over the pasta.
Toss quickly to coat the pasta. The heat from the pasta will cook the egg and create a creamy sauce. Add pasta water if too thick.

recipes.name: Vegan Chickpea Coconut Curry
recipes.description: A rich, flavorful, and comforting plant-based curry cooked in a creamy coconut milk base with aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger until soft and fragrant.
Add the curry powder and stir well to coat the aromatics for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the drained chickpeas. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and let it cook for 15 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the sauce to thicken.
Stir in the spinach leaves and cook for another 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt to taste and serve warm with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.name: Luxury Black Truffle Risotto
recipes.description: An exquisite and aromatic Italian rice dish cooked slowly with broth, white wine, and infused with premium black truffle oil.
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Sauté the shallot until translucent.
Add the Arborio rice and toast it for 2 minutes, stirring constantly until the edges are translucent.
Pour in the white wine and stir until completely absorbed by the rice.
Add the warm broth, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly. Wait until each ladle is absorbed before adding the next.
Continue this process for about 20 minutes until the rice is cooked but remains slightly firm (al dente).
Remove from heat, stir in the remaining butter, Parmesan cheese, and black truffle oil. Season with salt and pepper, cover for 2 minutes, and serve.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
recipes.description: A restaurant-quality juicy beef steak seared in a cast iron skillet with garlic butter, rosemary, and thyme.
ingredients: Coarse salt and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Remove the steak from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to bring it to room temperature. Pat dry with paper towels.
Season both sides generously with coarse salt and freshly cracked black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a heavy cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add the steak and sear for 2-3 minutes per side without moving it, to form a rich brown crust.
Reduce heat to medium-low, add butter, crushed garlic, rosemary, and thyme to the skillet.
Tilt the pan and spoon the melted butter continuously over the steak (basting) for 2 minutes for medium-rare.
Transfer the steak to a board and let it rest for 5-7 minutes before slicing. Serve with pan juices.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Chocolate Avocado Mousse
recipes.description: A velvety-smooth, healthy, and decadent chocolate dessert made with ripe avocados, cocoa powder, and natural sweeteners.
instructions: Add the scooped avocados, cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and salt to a high-speed blender or food processor.
Blend on high until the mixture is completely smooth, creamy, and free of lumps. Scrape down the sides as needed.
If the mousse is too thick, add a tablespoon of almond milk at a time to reach your desired consistency.
Transfer the mousse to serving bowls and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before serving.
Garnish with fresh raspberries or strawberries and a sprinkle of cocoa nibs before serving.

recipes.name: Signature Lobster Thermidor
recipes.description: An opulent French classic consisting of a creamy mixture of cooked lobster meat, egg yolks, and brandy, stuffed into a lobster shell.
instructions: Cut the lobsters in half lengthwise, remove the meat from the tails and claws, and chop it into bite-sized pieces. Save the shells.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Sauté shallots and mushrooms until soft.
Pour in brandy and carefully ignite or cook down, then add white wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in heavy cream and Dijon mustard. Simmer until the sauce coats the back of a spoon. Season with salt and pepper.
Fold the lobster meat into the sauce, then spoon the mixture back into the reserved lobster shells.
Sprinkle grated Gruyere cheese on top and broil under a hot grill for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.

recipes.name: Zesty Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.description: A light and healthy dinner featuring lemon-herb marinated salmon fillets grilled alongside fresh tender asparagus.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place the salmon fillets in a dish and pour half of the marinade over them. Toss the asparagus with the remaining marinade.
Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the salmon fillets skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and grill for another 3-4 minutes until cooked through.
Grill the asparagus alongside the salmon for 5-6 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender-crisp and lightly charred.
Serve the salmon and asparagus warm, garnished with extra lemon slices.

recipes.name: Classic Crispy Falafel Wrap
recipes.description: Authentic Middle Eastern falafel balls made from spiced ground chickpeas, fried till golden, and wrapped in warm flatbread with tahini.
ingredients: 1 cup Dried chickpeas (soaked overnight, not canned)
Flatbreads, tomatoes, cucumber, and Tahini sauce for assembly
instructions: Drain the soaked chickpeas and add them to a food processor along with the onion, parsley, cilantro, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Pulse until the mixture is finely ground but not pureed, resembling coarse sand.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour to help it bind.
Form the mixture into small balls or patties.
Heat 2 inches of vegetable oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C). Fry the falafel balls in batches for 3-4 minutes until deep golden brown.
Assemble wraps by placing falafel balls on flatbreads, adding chopped tomatoes, cucumbers, and drizzling with tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Grand Wagyu Beef Burger
recipes.description: The ultimate luxury burger featuring an incredibly juicy, melt-in-your-mouth Wagyu beef patty, caramelized onions, and truffle mayo on a toasted brioche bun.
instructions: Melt butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Cook sliced onions slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and dark golden.
Season the Wagyu patty generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat. Cook the patty for 3 minutes without moving to get a deep crust, then flip.
Top the patty with the cheddar cheese slice, cover the pan for 1-2 minutes until cheese melts and internal temp reaches medium-rare/medium.
Toast the brioche bun halves in the pan with a bit of butter until golden.
Assemble the burger: spread truffle mayo on the bottom bun, lay the butter lettuce, followed by the Wagyu patty with melted cheese, top with caramelized onions, and cover with the top bun.
